name: ReserveMap
description: Find restaurants where you can use premium credit card dining benefits. Covers Chase Sapphire Reserve, Amex Global Dining Access, Visa Dining Collection, and Dorsia.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Search restaurants by name, city, program, or cuisine

tools.name: get_restaurant_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific restaurant including dining programs and reservation links

tools.name: get_restaurants_near_location
tools.description: Find participating restaurants near a geographic location

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List all supported credit card dining programs

tools.name: get_program_cities
tools.description: List all cities that have restaurants for a given program

tools.name: navigate_to_restaurant
tools.description: Pan the map to a specific restaurant and open its detail view

tools.name: filter_map_by_program
tools.description: Filter the map to show only restaurants from a specific program

tools.name: open_reservation
tools.description: Get a reservation link for a restaurant on OpenTable or Resy
